sections.title: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland

rows.label: Personal income tax (PIT): progressive scale (podatek dochodowy od osób fizycznych) [national]
rows.value: 12% up to PLN 120,000 minus a tax-reducing amount of PLN 3,600; 32% above; flat 19% or lump-sum rates for business income by choice. Paid by resident and non-resident individuals (withheld by employers). Ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych, art. 27.
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: income-tax

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: consolidated text of the Personal Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych), art. 27 ust. 1

rows.label: Solidarity levy on incomes above PLN 1 million (danina solidarnościowa) [national]
rows.value: 4% of the excess over PLN 1,000,000. Paid by individuals with scale, flat-tax, capital-gains or foreign income above PLN 1,000,000. Ustawa o PIT, art. 30h.
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: solidarity-levy

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 30h ust. 1-2 (danina solidarnościowa)

rows.label: Capital gains tax on securities, shares and crypto-assets (podatek od zysków kapitałowych) [national]
rows.value: 19% of the gain. Paid by individuals selling securities, shares or virtual currencies. Ustawa o PIT, art. 30b ust. 1 and 1a.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 10 ust. 1, art. 30a ust. 1 and art. 30b ust. 1-1a

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (zryczałtowany podatek dochodowy) [national]
rows.value: 19% on dividends and interest for residents; non-residents: 20% on interest and royalties, 19% on dividends (individuals and companies), before treaty relief. Paid by recipients (withheld by the payer). Ustawa o PIT, art. 29 and 30a; ustawa o CIT, art. 21 and 22.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 10 ust. 1, art. 30a ust. 1 and art. 30b ust. 1-1a

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (przychody z najmu; emerytury i renty) [national]
rows.value: private rental: lump-sum 8.5% of revenue up to PLN 100,000 and 12.5% above; pensions taxed on the PIT scale like wages. Paid by landlords; pensioners. Ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym, art. 12 ust. 1 pkt 4; ustawa o PIT, art. 10 ust. 1 pkt 1.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2025 poz. 843: consolidated text of the Lump-sum Income Tax Act (ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym), art. 12 ust. 1 pkt 4

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (ograniczony obowiązek podatkowy) [national]
rows.value: pay for work done in Poland is taxed on the PIT scale with employer withholding; 20% flat on contracts of mandate, board fees and similar personal services of non-residents. Paid by non-resident employees (advances withheld by the employer). Ustawa o PIT, art. 3 ust. 1a, 2a and 2b, art. 29 and 32.
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 3 ust. 1, 1a, 2a and 2b

rows.label: Social insurance contributions (ZUS) (składki na ubezpieczenia społeczne) [national]
rows.value: pension 19.52% (split equally), disability 8% (employee 1.5%, employer 6.5%), sickness 2.45% (employee), accident 0.40% to 8.12% (employer). Paid by employees and employers. Ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych, art. 22.
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: zus-employee

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 199: consolidated text of the Social Insurance System Act (ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych), art. 16 and 22

rows.label: Employer levies: Labour Fund, Solidarity Fund, Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund and the PFRON disability levy (Fundusz Pracy, Fundusz Solidarnościowy, FGŚP, wpłaty na PFRON) [national]
rows.value: 1.00% + 1.45% + 0.10% of the contribution base; PFRON: 40.65% of the average wage per missing disabled employee below a 6% ratio (employers with 25 or more full-time staff). Paid by employers. Ustawa budżetowa na rok 2026, art. 25-27; ustawa o rehabilitacji [...] osób niepełnosprawnych, art. 21.
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 62: Ustawa budżetowa na rok 2026, art. 25-27

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (ZUS) (składki ZUS przedsiębiorców) [national]
rows.value: on a base of at least PLN 5,652 a month in 2026 (PLN 1,926.76 with voluntary sickness insurance); preferential base PLN 1,441.80 for 24 months. Paid by self-employed persons. Ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych, art. 18 and 18a.
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: freelancers

source.title: ZUS: Informacja o wysokości składek na ubezpieczenia społeczne w 2026 r. (osoby prowadzące działalność gospodarczą)

rows.label: Contractor rules: employment test and withholding on contracts of mandate (umowa o pracę, umowa zlecenia, umowa o dzieło) [national]
rows.value: work under direction at a set place and time is employment whatever the contract is called; payers withhold 12% advances on contract income, 12% final tax on contracts of up to PLN 200, 20% for non-residents. Paid by clients (as withholding agents) and contractors. Kodeks pracy, art. 22; ustawa o PIT, art. 5b, 13 pkt 8, 29, 30 ust. 1 pkt 5a and 41.
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1245: consolidated text of the Labour Code (Kodeks pracy), art. 22

rows.label: Employee capital plans (PPK): the occupational pension scheme (pracownicze plany kapitałowe) [national]
rows.value: basic payments 2% employee and 1.5% employer, plus optional extras. Paid by employees (2%) and employers (1.5%), unless the employee opts out. Ustawa o pracowniczych planach kapitałowych, art. 26-27.
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: ppk

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 192: consolidated text of the Employee Capital Plans Act (ustawa o pracowniczych planach kapitałowych), art. 26-27

rows.label: Corporate income tax (CIT) (podatek dochodowy od osób prawnych) [national]
rows.value: 19%; 9% for small taxpayers (revenue up to EUR 2 million, not capital gains); banks 30% and cooperative banks 27% in tax years starting in 2026; 10% minimum tax; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Ustawa o CIT, art. 19, 24ca and 38aa-38ab; ustawa o opodatkowaniu wyrównawczym (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1685).
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 554: consolidated text of the Corporate Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób prawnych), art. 19, 24ca, 28o and 38aa-38ab

rows.label: Simplified regimes: lump-sum tax on recorded revenue (ryczałt) and the flat 19% tax (ryczałt od przychodów ewidencjonowanych; podatek liniowy) [national]
rows.value: ryczałt 2% to 17% of revenue by activity (revenue up to EUR 2,000,000); flat 19% on business income. Paid by sole traders by written choice. Ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym, art. 6 and 12; ustawa o PIT, art. 30c.
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: ryczalt

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2025 poz. 843: Lump-sum Income Tax Act, art. 6 ust. 4 and art. 12 ust. 1

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits (Estonian CIT) and withholding on profits paid abroad (ryczałt od dochodów spółek) [national]
rows.value: Estonian CIT on distributed profit 10% (small and new taxpayers) or 20%; 19% withholding on dividends paid to non-residents. Paid by companies that opt in (Estonian CIT); recipients of dividends. Ustawa o CIT, art. 22 and 28o.
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 554: consolidated text of the Corporate Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób prawnych), art. 19, 24ca, 28o and 38aa-38ab

rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (podatek od towarów i usług) [national]
rows.value: 23% standard, 8% and 5% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by VAT-registered businesses). Ustawa o podatku od towarów i usług, art. 41 and 146ef.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1263: consolidated text of the VAT Act (ustawa o podatku od towarów i usług), art. 41, 113 and 146ef

rows.label: Excise duties on alcohol, tobacco, fuel, electricity and passenger cars (podatek akcyzowy) [national]
rows.value: spirits PLN 8,811 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes PLN 476.10 per 1,000 + 32.05% of the retail price; petrol PLN 1,529 and diesel PLN 1,160 per 1,000 l (cut to 1,239 and 880 from 3 October to 31 December 2026); electricity PLN 5 per MWh; cars 3.1% or 18.6%. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Ustawa o podatku akcyzowym, art. 89, 93-99 and 105; Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1289.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 412: consolidated text of the Excise Duty Act (ustawa o podatku akcyzowym), art. 89, 93-99 and 105

rows.label: Special consumption tax on sweetened drinks: the sugar fee (opłata od środków spożywczych) [national]
rows.value: PLN 0.50 per litre plus PLN 0.05 per gram of sugar above 5 g per 100 ml, PLN 0.10 per litre for caffeine or taurine; at most PLN 1.20 per litre. Paid by sellers of sweetened drinks to retailers. Ustawa o zdrowiu publicznym, art. 12a-12f.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 149: consolidated text of the Public Health Act (ustawa o zdrowiu publicznym), art. 12f

rows.label: Tax on certain financial institutions (banks' and insurers' assets) (podatek od niektórych instytucji finansowych) [national]
rows.value: 0.0366% of the taxable assets a month. Paid by banks, insurers and lenders. Ustawa o podatku od niektórych instytucji finansowych, art. 7.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: special-taxes

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2023 poz. 623: consolidated text of the Act on the tax on certain financial institutions (ustawa o podatku od niektórych instytucji finansowych), art. 7

rows.label: Retail sales tax (podatek od sprzedaży detalicznej) [national]
rows.value: 0.8% of monthly revenue above PLN 17 million up to PLN 170 million; 1.4% above. Paid by retailers with monthly retail revenue above PLN 17 million. Ustawa o podatku od sprzedaży detalicznej, art. 6 and 8.
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: special-taxes

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2023 poz. 148: consolidated text of the Retail Sales Tax Act (ustawa o podatku od sprzedaży detalicznej), art. 6 and 8

rows.label: Windfall tax on profits from the sale of liquid fuels (March 2026 to March 2027) (podatek od nadzwyczajnych zysków ze zbycia paliw ciekłych) [national]
rows.value: 60% of the extraordinary profit. Paid by sellers of liquid fuels. Ustawa z dnia 18 września 2026 r. (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1287), art. 8.
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: special-taxes

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1287: Ustawa z dnia 18 września 2026 r. o podatku od nadzwyczajnych zysków osiągniętych w okresie od marca 2026 r. do marca 2027 r. ze zbycia paliw ciekłych

rows.label: Property tax on land and buildings (podatek od nieruchomości) [municipal]
rows.value: rates set by each municipal council up to statutory maxima: 2026 residential buildings PLN 1.25 per m2, business buildings PLN 35.53 per m2, business land PLN 1.45 per m2; structures 2% of value. Paid by owners of land, buildings and structures. Ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych, art. 5; M.P. 2025 poz. 726.

rows.label: Tax on civil-law transactions (PCC): property transfer and other contracts (podatek od czynności cywilnoprawnych) [national]
rows.value: 2% on the sale of real estate and movables; 1% on other property rights; exemption for first-home buyers of resale homes; 0.1% on mortgages. Paid by the buyer (collected by the notary). Ustawa o podatku od czynności cywilnoprawnych, art. 4, 7 and 9.
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 191: consolidated text of the Tax on Civil Law Transactions Act (ustawa o podatku od czynności cywilnoprawnych), art. 4, 7, 9 and 10

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (podatek od spadków i darowizn) [national]
rows.value: 3% to 20% by tax group above tax-free amounts of PLN 36,120 (group I), 27,090 (II) and 5,733 (III); spouses, descendants, ascendants, siblings and step-parents exempt if they report. Paid by heirs and recipients of gifts. Ustawa o podatku od spadków i darowizn, art. 4a, 9, 14 and 15.

source.title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 478: consolidated text of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act (ustawa o podatku od spadków i darowizn), art. 4a, 9, 14 and 15

rows.value: annual maxima set nationally (2026: e.g. PLN 1,259.09 for lorries of 3.5 to 5.5 t, PLN 2,976.21 for buses with fewer than 22 seats); car excise 3.1% or 18.6% of value. Paid by owners of lorries over 3.5 t, tractor units, trailers and buses; first registration of passenger cars (excise). rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: income-tax
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: consolidated text of the Personal Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych), art. 27 ust. 1
rows.label: Personal income tax (PIT): progressive scale (podatek dochodowy od osób fizycznych) [national]
rows.value: 12% up to PLN 120,000 minus a tax-reducing amount of PLN 3,600; 32% above; flat 19% or lump-sum rates for business income by choice. Paid by resident and non-resident individuals (withheld by employers). Ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych, art. 27.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: solidarity-levy
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 30h ust. 1-2 (danina solidarnościowa)
rows.label: Solidarity levy on incomes above PLN 1 million (danina solidarnościowa) [national]
rows.value: 4% of the excess over PLN 1,000,000. Paid by individuals with scale, flat-tax, capital-gains or foreign income above PLN 1,000,000. Ustawa o PIT, art. 30h.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 10 ust. 1, art. 30a ust. 1 and art. 30b ust. 1-1a
rows.label: Capital gains tax on securities, shares and crypto-assets (podatek od zysków kapitałowych) [national]
rows.value: 19% of the gain. Paid by individuals selling securities, shares or virtual currencies. Ustawa o PIT, art. 30b ust. 1 and 1a.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 10 ust. 1, art. 30a ust. 1 and art. 30b ust. 1-1a
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (zryczałtowany podatek dochodowy) [national]
rows.value: 19% on dividends and interest for residents; non-residents: 20% on interest and royalties, 19% on dividends (individuals and companies), before treaty relief. Paid by recipients (withheld by the payer). Ustawa o PIT, art. 29 and 30a; ustawa o CIT, art. 21 and 22.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2025 poz. 843: consolidated text of the Lump-sum Income Tax Act (ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym), art. 12 ust. 1 pkt 4
rows.label: Rental income and pension income (przychody z najmu; emerytury i renty) [national]
rows.value: private rental: lump-sum 8.5% of revenue up to PLN 100,000 and 12.5% above; pensions taxed on the PIT scale like wages. Paid by landlords; pensioners. Ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym, art. 12 ust. 1 pkt 4; ustawa o PIT, art. 10 ust. 1 pkt 1.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 592: Personal Income Tax Act, art. 3 ust. 1, 1a, 2a and 2b
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (ograniczony obowiązek podatkowy) [national]
rows.value: pay for work done in Poland is taxed on the PIT scale with employer withholding; 20% flat on contracts of mandate, board fees and similar personal services of non-residents. Paid by non-resident employees (advances withheld by the employer). Ustawa o PIT, art. 3 ust. 1a, 2a and 2b, art. 29 and 32.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: zus-employee
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 199: consolidated text of the Social Insurance System Act (ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych), art. 16 and 22
rows.label: Social insurance contributions (ZUS) (składki na ubezpieczenia społeczne) [national]
rows.value: pension 19.52% (split equally), disability 8% (employee 1.5%, employer 6.5%), sickness 2.45% (employee), accident 0.40% to 8.12% (employer). Paid by employees and employers. Ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych, art. 22.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 62: Ustawa budżetowa na rok 2026, art. 25-27
rows.label: Employer levies: Labour Fund, Solidarity Fund, Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund and the PFRON disability levy (Fundusz Pracy, Fundusz Solidarnościowy, FGŚP, wpłaty na PFRON) [national]
rows.value: 1.00% + 1.45% + 0.10% of the contribution base; PFRON: 40.65% of the average wage per missing disabled employee below a 6% ratio (employers with 25 or more full-time staff). Paid by employers. Ustawa budżetowa na rok 2026, art. 25-27; ustawa o rehabilitacji [...] osób niepełnosprawnych, art. 21.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: ZUS: Informacja o wysokości składek na ubezpieczenia społeczne w 2026 r. (osoby prowadzące działalność gospodarczą)
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (ZUS) (składki ZUS przedsiębiorców) [national]
rows.value: on a base of at least PLN 5,652 a month in 2026 (PLN 1,926.76 with voluntary sickness insurance); preferential base PLN 1,441.80 for 24 months. Paid by self-employed persons. Ustawa o systemie ubezpieczeń społecznych, art. 18 and 18a.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1245: consolidated text of the Labour Code (Kodeks pracy), art. 22
rows.label: Contractor rules: employment test and withholding on contracts of mandate (umowa o pracę, umowa zlecenia, umowa o dzieło) [national]
rows.value: work under direction at a set place and time is employment whatever the contract is called; payers withhold 12% advances on contract income, 12% final tax on contracts of up to PLN 200, 20% for non-residents. Paid by clients (as withholding agents) and contractors. Kodeks pracy, art. 22; ustawa o PIT, art. 5b, 13 pkt 8, 29, 30 ust. 1 pkt 5a and 41.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: ppk
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 192: consolidated text of the Employee Capital Plans Act (ustawa o pracowniczych planach kapitałowych), art. 26-27
rows.label: Employee capital plans (PPK): the occupational pension scheme (pracownicze plany kapitałowe) [national]
rows.value: basic payments 2% employee and 1.5% employer, plus optional extras. Paid by employees (2%) and employers (1.5%), unless the employee opts out. Ustawa o pracowniczych planach kapitałowych, art. 26-27.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 554: consolidated text of the Corporate Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób prawnych), art. 19, 24ca, 28o and 38aa-38ab
rows.label: Corporate income tax (CIT) (podatek dochodowy od osób prawnych) [national]
rows.value: 19%; 9% for small taxpayers (revenue up to EUR 2 million, not capital gains); banks 30% and cooperative banks 27% in tax years starting in 2026; 10% minimum tax; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Ustawa o CIT, art. 19, 24ca and 38aa-38ab; ustawa o opodatkowaniu wyrównawczym (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1685).

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: ryczalt
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2025 poz. 843: Lump-sum Income Tax Act, art. 6 ust. 4 and art. 12 ust. 1
rows.label: Simplified regimes: lump-sum tax on recorded revenue (ryczałt) and the flat 19% tax (ryczałt od przychodów ewidencjonowanych; podatek liniowy) [national]
rows.value: ryczałt 2% to 17% of revenue by activity (revenue up to EUR 2,000,000); flat 19% on business income. Paid by sole traders by written choice. Ustawa o zryczałtowanym podatku dochodowym, art. 6 and 12; ustawa o PIT, art. 30c.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 554: consolidated text of the Corporate Income Tax Act (ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób prawnych), art. 19, 24ca, 28o and 38aa-38ab
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits (Estonian CIT) and withholding on profits paid abroad (ryczałt od dochodów spółek) [national]
rows.value: Estonian CIT on distributed profit 10% (small and new taxpayers) or 20%; 19% withholding on dividends paid to non-residents. Paid by companies that opt in (Estonian CIT); recipients of dividends. Ustawa o CIT, art. 22 and 28o.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1263: consolidated text of the VAT Act (ustawa o podatku od towarów i usług), art. 41, 113 and 146ef
rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (podatek od towarów i usług) [national]
rows.value: 23% standard, 8% and 5% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by VAT-registered businesses). Ustawa o podatku od towarów i usług, art. 41 and 146ef.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 412: consolidated text of the Excise Duty Act (ustawa o podatku akcyzowym), art. 89, 93-99 and 105
rows.label: Excise duties on alcohol, tobacco, fuel, electricity and passenger cars (podatek akcyzowy) [national]
rows.value: spirits PLN 8,811 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes PLN 476.10 per 1,000 + 32.05% of the retail price; petrol PLN 1,529 and diesel PLN 1,160 per 1,000 l (cut to 1,239 and 880 from 3 October to 31 December 2026); electricity PLN 5 per MWh; cars 3.1% or 18.6%. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Ustawa o podatku akcyzowym, art. 89, 93-99 and 105; Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1289.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 149: consolidated text of the Public Health Act (ustawa o zdrowiu publicznym), art. 12f
rows.label: Special consumption tax on sweetened drinks: the sugar fee (opłata od środków spożywczych) [national]
rows.value: PLN 0.50 per litre plus PLN 0.05 per gram of sugar above 5 g per 100 ml, PLN 0.10 per litre for caffeine or taurine; at most PLN 1.20 per litre. Paid by sellers of sweetened drinks to retailers. Ustawa o zdrowiu publicznym, art. 12a-12f.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: special-taxes
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2023 poz. 623: consolidated text of the Act on the tax on certain financial institutions (ustawa o podatku od niektórych instytucji finansowych), art. 7
rows.label: Tax on certain financial institutions (banks' and insurers' assets) (podatek od niektórych instytucji finansowych) [national]
rows.value: 0.0366% of the taxable assets a month. Paid by banks, insurers and lenders. Ustawa o podatku od niektórych instytucji finansowych, art. 7.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: special-taxes
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2023 poz. 148: consolidated text of the Retail Sales Tax Act (ustawa o podatku od sprzedaży detalicznej), art. 6 and 8
rows.label: Retail sales tax (podatek od sprzedaży detalicznej) [national]
rows.value: 0.8% of monthly revenue above PLN 17 million up to PLN 170 million; 1.4% above. Paid by retailers with monthly retail revenue above PLN 17 million. Ustawa o podatku od sprzedaży detalicznej, art. 6 and 8.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: special-taxes
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1287: Ustawa z dnia 18 września 2026 r. o podatku od nadzwyczajnych zysków osiągniętych w okresie od marca 2026 r. do marca 2027 r. ze zbycia paliw ciekłych
rows.label: Windfall tax on profits from the sale of liquid fuels (March 2026 to March 2027) (podatek od nadzwyczajnych zysków ze zbycia paliw ciekłych) [national]
rows.value: 60% of the extraordinary profit. Paid by sellers of liquid fuels. Ustawa z dnia 18 września 2026 r. (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1287), art. 8.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax

rows.label: Property tax on land and buildings (podatek od nieruchomości) [municipal]
rows.value: rates set by each municipal council up to statutory maxima: 2026 residential buildings PLN 1.25 per m2, business buildings PLN 35.53 per m2, business land PLN 1.45 per m2; structures 2% of value. Paid by owners of land, buildings and structures. Ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych, art. 5; M.P. 2025 poz. 726.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer

rows.label: Tax on civil-law transactions (PCC): property transfer and other contracts (podatek od czynności cywilnoprawnych) [national]
rows.value: 2% on the sale of real estate and movables; 1% on other property rights; exemption for first-home buyers of resale homes; 0.1% on mortgages. Paid by the buyer (collected by the notary). Ustawa o podatku od czynności cywilnoprawnych, art. 4, 7 and 9.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance-gift
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 478: consolidated text of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act (ustawa o podatku od spadków i darowizn), art. 4a, 9, 14 and 15
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (podatek od spadków i darowizn) [national]
rows.value: 3% to 20% by tax group above tax-free amounts of PLN 36,120 (group I), 27,090 (II) and 5,733 (III); spouses, descendants, ascendants, siblings and step-parents exempt if they report. Paid by heirs and recipients of gifts. Ustawa o podatku od spadków i darowizn, art. 4a, 9, 14 and 15.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: Monitor Polski 2025 poz. 726: Obwieszczenie Ministra Finansów i Gospodarki z dnia 1 sierpnia 2025 r. w sprawie górnych granic stawek kwotowych podatków i opłat lokalnych na rok 2026
rows.label: Vehicle taxes: tax on means of transport and excise duty on passenger cars (podatek od środków transportowych; akcyza od samochodów osobowych) [municipal]
rows.value: annual maxima set nationally (2026: e.g. PLN 1,259.09 for lorries of 3.5 to 5.5 t, PLN 2,976.21 for buses with fewer than 22 seats); car excise 3.1% or 18.6% of value. Paid by owners of lorries over 3.5 t, tractor units, trailers and buses; first registration of passenger cars (excise). Ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych, art. 8 and 10; ustawa o podatku akcyzowym, art. 105.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax
rows.source_title: Monitor Polski 2025 poz. 726: Obwieszczenie Ministra Finansów i Gospodarki z dnia 1 sierpnia 2025 r. w sprawie górnych granic stawek kwotowych podatków i opłat lokalnych na rok 2026
rows.label: Local fee and spa fee for overnight stays (tourist tax) (opłata miejscowa, opłata uzdrowiskowa) [municipal]
rows.value: 2026 maxima per day: local fee PLN 3.46 (PLN 4.89 in spa protection areas), spa fee PLN 6.67; from 1 January 2027 per night: PLN 5.00, 5.50 and 6.86. Paid by visitors staying overnight in designated places (collected by the accommodation provider from 2027). Ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych, art. 17 and 19; Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1354.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and travel allowances (cło, podatek VAT z tytułu importu) [EU]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 3 per item on consignments up to EUR 150 (IOSS or post) from 1 July 2026; import VAT at the Polish rates; travellers EUR 430 (air, sea) or EUR 300 (land). Paid by importers and travellers from outside the EU. Regulation (EC) No 1186/2009 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/382; Directive 2007/74/EC; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item H1; detailed table: stamp-duties
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1395: consolidated text of the Stamp Duty Act (ustawa o opłacie skarbowej), art. 1 and the annex (tariff)
rows.label: Stamp duty on documents and official acts (opłata skarbowa) [municipal]
rows.value: fixed amounts by tariff, e.g. PLN 17 for a power of attorney and PLN 340 for a temporary residence permit. Paid by applicants for official acts, certificates and permits; filers of powers of attorney. Ustawa o opłacie skarbowej, art. 1 and the annex.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item H2; detailed table: local-fees
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2025 poz. 885: Rozporządzenie Krajowej Rady Radiofonii i Telewizji z dnia 27 czerwca 2025 r. w sprawie wysokości opłat abonamentowych [...] w 2026 r.
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (abonament radiowo-telewizyjny) [national]
rows.value: 2026: PLN 9.50 a month (radio) or PLN 30.50 (television); 2027: PLN 10.80 and PLN 34.50. Paid by users of radio and television receivers. Ustawa o opłatach abonamentowych, art. 3; Dz.U. 2025 poz. 885 and Dz.U. 2026 poz. 664.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item H2; detailed table: local-fees

rows.label: Communal fees (local fees): dog fee, market fee and advertising fee (opłata od posiadania psów, opłata targowa, opłata reklamowa) [municipal]
rows.value: 2026 maxima: dog fee PLN 186.29 a year, market fee PLN 1,176.67 a day, advertising fee PLN 3.89 a day plus PLN 0.36 per m2. Paid by dog owners, market traders, owners of advertising boards (where the council levies them). Ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych, art. 19; M.P. 2025 poz. 726.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers

rows.label: New residents: relocation relief (ulga na powrót) (ulga na powrót) [national]
rows.value: up to PLN 85,528 a year of income exempt for four years. Paid by individuals who move their tax residence to Poland. Ustawa o PIT, art. 21 ust. 1 pkt 152.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item A3
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1252: Obwieszczenie Marszałka Sejmu z dnia 1 września 2026 r. w sprawie ogłoszenia jednolitego tekstu ustawy o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego, arts 4 to 8
rows.label: Regional or municipal income tax: none (shares of national income taxes) (udziały w PIT i CIT) [national]
rows.value: None: local governments levy no income tax; they receive shares of PIT computed on the income of resident taxpayers (municipality 7.0%, city with county rights 8.6%, county 2.0%, voivodeship 0.35%) and of CIT on the income of companies seated there (1.6%, 2.2%, 1.7% and 2.3%). Paid by no one. Ustawa o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1252), arts 4 to 8.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland

rows.label: Church tax: none (Church Fund financed by state subsidies) (Fundusz Kościelny) [national]
rows.value: None: churches receive support from the Church Fund, formed from state subsidies, for church upkeep, aid and insurance for clergy and charitable work. Paid by no one. Ustawa z dnia 20 marca 1950 r. (Dz.U. 1950 nr 9 poz. 87), arts 8 and 9.

rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1252: Obwieszczenie Marszałka Sejmu z dnia 1 września 2026 r. w sprawie ogłoszenia jednolitego tekstu ustawy o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego, arts 4 to 8
rows.label: Local business tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: municipal own revenues are the property, agricultural, forest and transport taxes, the tax-card income tax, inheritance and gift tax, civil-law transactions tax and local fees (stamp, market, local, spa, dog, advertising and extraction fees); there is no municipal business or trade tax. Paid by no one. Ustawa o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego, art. 4.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1252: Obwieszczenie Marszałka Sejmu z dnia 1 września 2026 r. w sprawie ogłoszenia jednolitego tekstu ustawy o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego, arts 4 to 8
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: VAT and excise duties are state taxes; the own revenues of municipalities, counties and voivodeships include no sales or consumption tax. Paid by no one. Ustawa o dochodach jednostek samorządu terytorialnego, arts 4 to 7.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Poland

rows.source_title: Monitor Polski 2025 poz. 769: Obwieszczenie Ministra Klimatu i Środowiska z dnia 6 sierpnia 2025 r. w sprawie wysokości stawek opłat za korzystanie ze środowiska na rok 2026
rows.label: Environmental charges: fees for the use of the environment (opłaty za korzystanie ze środowiska) [national]
rows.value: 2026 rates: sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides PLN 0.81 per kg, carbon dioxide PLN 0.45 per tonne emitted; upper rates PLN 591.16 per kg of gases or dust and PLN 433.08 per tonne of waste landfilled. Paid by businesses that emit gases or dust or landfill waste. Prawo ochrony środowiska, art. 291; Obwieszczenie Ministra Klimatu i Środowiska (M.P. 2025 poz. 769).
